job.job_title: Infosys Evolve | Lead AI & GenAI Engineer | Women Returnship Program
job.job_description:
Upskill with purpose. Build expertise. Evolve with confidence.




Infosys EVOLVE is a structured career acceleration program designed for women professionals looking to build future-ready skills and stay ahead in the evolving technology landscape. As part of our Restart with Infosys initiative, we welcome women professionals returning to the workforce after a career break of 6 months or more, with a minimum of 2 years of IT experience.




What You Gain

Training in high-demand technologies
Curated learning paths aligned to your experience and career aspirations
Hands-on learning through projects, assessments, and expert mentoring
Enhanced readiness for future career opportunities



Role & responsibilities

Design and deliver enterprise-grade GenAI, RAG, and AI Automation solutions.
Lead technical implementation of AI initiatives and guide engineering teams on solution delivery.
Develop scalable AI architectures using industry-standard frameworks and best practices.
Establish and support MLOps/LLMOps practices including deployment, monitoring, observability, and governance.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to identify and implement high-value AI use cases.
Mentor engineers and contribute to technical reviews, solution quality, and delivery excellence.
Ensure Responsible AI adoption, security, compliance, and governance standards are followed.
Drive reusable frameworks, accelerators, and innovation initiatives to improve engineering productivity.
